newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields fall at auction.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields fall at auction.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-month, six-month, nine-month and 12-month Ukraine discount treasury bills edged down from previous sales, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.

Three-month bills slipped to 23.34 percent from 23.93 percent, six-month bills edged down to 25.40 percent from 27.01 percent, nine-month bills slipped to 28.91 percent from 28.99 percent and 12-month bills edged down to 32.14 percent from 32.98 percent.
The results of Tuesday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 5.00 million UAH 6.00 million UAH
Amount sold 5.00 million UAH 6.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 4.72 million UAH 5.66 million UAH
The central bank sold 50,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 15.
Results of six-month T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 9.00 million UAH 10.00 million UAH
Amount sold 9.00 million UAH 10.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 7.99 million UAH 8.81 million UAH
The central bank sold 90,000 T-bills, the bank statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 15.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 24.00 million UAH 6.90 million UAH
Amount sold 13.09 million UAH 6.90 million UAH
Actual amount raised 10.77 million UAH 5.67 million UAH
The central bank sold 130,990 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 15.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 31.00 million UAH 18.00 million UAH
Amount sold 31.00 million UAH 18.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 23.48 million UAH 13.54 million UAH
The central bank sold 310,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for May 15.
